title: Physician Client Accounts — Invoicing, Payment and Adjustment Terms by Class
content:
Each class of Physician Client Accounts carries its own invoicing and payment terms and its own windows for disputing an invoice or obtaining a credit memo. A client invoice covers the prior calendar month and is issued on a fixed day of the following month.

## Invoicing and payment

| Account class | Client invoice for the prior month issued on day | Payment due (calendar days after the invoice date) | Early-payment discount | Early-payment period (calendar days after the invoice date) | Accepted payment methods | One consolidated client invoice for all locations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | 1 | 30 | none (0 percent) | none (0) | ACH bank transfer, check, credit card | No |
| Group Practice Client Account | 1 | 30 | none (0 percent) | none (0) | ACH bank transfer, check, credit card | Yes |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | 1 | 30 | 1 percent | 10 | ACH bank transfer, check | Yes |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | 1 | 45 | none (0 percent) | none (0) | ACH bank transfer, check | Yes |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | 1 | 45 | 1 percent | 10 | ACH bank transfer only | Yes |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | 1 | 30 | none (0 percent) | none (0) | ACH bank transfer, check, credit card | Yes |

## Dispute and credit memo windows

| Account class | Invoice dispute window (calendar days after the invoice date) | Credit memo window (calendar days after the line was billed) | Supporting documentation for a credit memo |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | 60 | 90 | Required |
| Group Practice Client Account | 60 | 90 | Required |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | 60 | 90 | Required |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | 90 | 120 | Required |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | 90 | 120 | Required |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | 60 | 90 | Required |

## Terms explained

- **Early-payment discount**: the percentage off a client invoice paid in full within the early-payment period. Only the Multispecialty Medical Group Account and the Hospital Outreach Reference Account offer one: 1 percent within 10 calendar days of the invoice date. A figure of 0 means the class offers none.
- **Accepted payment methods**: the ways the laboratory accepts payment from the organization. Credit card is accepted only for the Independent Practice, Group Practice and Occupational Health Employer classes; the Hospital Outreach Reference Account pays by ACH bank transfer only.
- **Consolidated invoice**: where the class says Yes, all of the organization's locations receive one consolidated client invoice. The Independent Practice Client Account, which admits a single location, is invoiced on its own.
- **Supporting documentation**: every class requires it for a credit memo, for example the patient's coverage card.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

The client invoice of a Federally Qualified Health Center Account for April lines is issued on 1 May; payment falls due 45 calendar days after that date, on 15 June. The same invoice of a Group Practice Client Account, due 30 calendar days after 1 May, falls due on 31 May.
